title: Boyacá necklace bomb incident
text: The Boyacá necklace bomb incident was an extortion attack that took place on 15 May 2000 in Chiquinquirá, in the Boyacá Department of Colombia. A woman named Elvia Cortés was killed after assailants locked an explosive device around her neck and demanded a ransom. The device detonated while authorities attempted to remove it, also killing a bomb disposal technician and injuring several others.
